cases.document_identity: Environmental Planning Commission Recommendations / Official Notice of Decision for Project 1002358 / 02EPC-01768, Mayor's Proposed 2003-2012 Decade Plan for Capital Improvements; 15 pages; January 16-17, 2003.
established_facts: The official City original and existing R2 object were already verified byte-identical; factual master-to-R2 linkage is complete.

The packet records the EPC public hearing, staff presentation, public comment, findings, unanimous final action forwarding approval to the Mayor and recommendation to City Council, and appeal information.
It is not a notice merely announcing a future hearing, and it is not the enacted City Council capital program.
new_research: Temporary read-only inspection confirmed the packet's final-action text and hearing transcript.

Repository precedent: validated src-e8d18ebb99858984, the Volcano Trails Environmental Planning Commission Official Notice of Decision, is visibly retained on content/development-land-use/area-sector-plans.md because it records a recommendation, findings, analysis, testimony, and conditions forwarded to City Council.
Repository distinction: a pending EPC hearing notice (src-385036989b8d1925) has no archival or publication treatment; the retained Volcano Trails record is a completed decision, not advance notice.

authoritative_evidence.role: official City source and established byte-identical original
official City source for the repository's comparable retained EPC Notice of Decision
official City project page used as source provenance for the comparable record

cases.repository_precedent: The repository objectively retains completed, substantive EPC decision records that contain findings and a recommendation/decision relationship to later Council action; it does not establish a precedent for retaining mere hearing notices.
cases.research_outcome: Document class is resolved: this packet is a substantive EPC final-decision/recommendation record and is consistently retainable in local accounting. The existing factual R2 linkage is appropriate.
cases.user_decision_required: No document-class policy decision is required. Any future visible placement on the capital-spending page remains a separately authorized content decision.

cases.document_identity: One-page City map titled 'Water Master Plan Infrastructure Zone (WIZ)', labeled B-6.
established_facts: The official City original and existing R2 object were already verified byte-identical; factual master-to-R2 linkage is complete.
The saved exhaustive Municipal Development document-library crawl places the file in the City's 2003 GO Bond Documents collection.

Visual inspection confirms a self-contained citywide zone-boundary map, its title, legend, and B-6 page label; it supplies no report title, author, date, appendix title, or parent-document identification.
new_research: Searched current and legacy City/CIP planning paths, the saved 2003 bond-directory inventory, repository research/history, and exact-title web queries.

Located current City references to the historical Master Plan for Water Supply, but no authoritative source ties this specific B-6 map to a named parent document or supplies the missing appendix sequence.
The existing official 2003 GO Bond collection is the strongest provenance available for the standalone map; the parent plan remains unidentified.

authoritative_evidence.role: official City CIP document collection that identifies the 2003 GO Bond Documents group
current City code reference to the historical Master Plan for Water Supply; contextual only, not parent-document proof

cases.repository_precedent: The repository normally retains complete plans and maps with direct official provenance, but no saved precedent establishes publication of an unidentified appendix sheet as though it were a complete parent plan.
cases.research_outcome: Parent document not located or identified. The map is confidently an official standalone City-filed representation of the WIZ boundary, but its B-6 label prevents claiming a complete-plan relationship.
unresolved_factual_questions: What document's Appendix B contains page B-6?
Whether any parent plan remains publicly available or is only available through a City records request.
cases.user_decision_required: Yes: choose whether official collection provenance is sufficient to retain/use the map as an explicitly standalone appendix map, or require parent-plan identification before any visible use.

options_and_consequences.option: Keep factual accounting only and defer visible use until the parent is identified.
options_and_consequences.r2_retention: retain factual object; no deletion inference

options_and_consequences.option: Authorize later treatment as a standalone official 'Water Master Plan Infrastructure Zone (WIZ) map (appendix page B-6; parent not located)'.
options_and_consequences.master_status: requires normal description/placement validation after authorization

cases.document_identity: Development Process Manual Executive Committee agenda scheduled for April 4, 2018, 2:00 p.m., Plaza del Sol Basement Hearing Room.
established_facts: The official City original and existing R2 object were already verified byte-identical; factual master-to-R2 linkage is complete.
The agenda schedules approval of the March 7 minutes and action on proposed Chapter 2 section 2.4 and Chapter 23 section 3.9.7.
The March 21, 2018 official agenda names April 4, 2018 as the next meeting date.
new_research: Reviewed the saved DPM research, current official DPM agendas-and-minutes page, current official directory listing, direct agenda text, targeted alternate-filename/phrase searches, and the March 7 neighboring official minutes.

The current official City historical page lists March 7, March 21, and April 4 agendas for 2018, but lists minutes only for February 7, February 21, and March 7. The directory likewise lists the April 4 agenda and no April 4 minutes file.
No official cancellation, rescheduling, no-quorum record, April 4 approved minutes, or later official minute confirming the April 4 meeting was located.

authoritative_evidence.role: current official historical listing: April 4 agenda is present; no April 2018 minutes are listed
official neighboring agenda scheduling April 4 as the next meeting
official neighboring approved minutes; schedules March 21 as the next meeting

cases.repository_precedent: The missing-minutes policy excludes agendas when approved minutes exist, and permits an agenda labeled 'Agenda (approved minutes not located)' only after exhaustive official-source review finds no approved minutes and the meeting was not cancelled or without quorum.
cases.research_outcome: Approved minutes not located after the recorded official-source review. Evidence establishes that the meeting was scheduled, but is insufficient to establish that it occurred or was not cancelled/without quorum.
unresolved_factual_questions: If it occurred, were minutes approved later but never published or retained on an archived City path?
Was it cancelled, rescheduled, or without quorum?
cases.user_decision_required: Yes: either require additional official records evidence before agenda preservation, or explicitly authorize a policy exception based on the scheduled agenda and the documented absence of published minutes.

options_and_consequences.option: Keep factual accounting only and retain requires-human-review status pending proof of meeting occurrence/non-cancellation.
options_and_consequences.r2_retention: retain factual object; no publication inference

options_and_consequences.option: Authorize later agenda preservation with the exact label 'Agenda (approved minutes not located)' despite unresolved occurrence/cancellation evidence.
options_and_consequences.master_status: requires normal policy/placement validation after authorization
options_and_consequences.site_visibility: only after a separately authorized content change; it must never be presented as minutes or an approved substitute
